admission: Same label-independent complete-original-evidence admission for positive/negative classes. Human-source frame means HGNC assignments in the extracted evidence, not independently validated biological species/identity.
consensus: Secondary prespecified intersection: prune iff both native_counts and Nemotron propose prune. Otherwise retain or abstain as documented. No selecting best arm after labels.
labels: Author positive tags correct/hypothesis/act_vs_amt. Mixed binary source votes are incorrect under author rule. Claim positive if any reviewed source positive; negative only if all original evidence sources reviewed and negative. Other corpus cases remain unknown/excluded.

model_review.aggregate: retain if any supports; prune_candidate if all fails; otherwise abstain. Invalid, truncated, oversized or interrupted sources abstain. Durable request intent prevents repeating an uncertain request.
model_review.context_preflight: Use installed server native chat tokenizer, actual full final prompt; prompt+reserved output <=16384. No partial source inspection.
model_review.prompt_location: INSTRUCTIONS in pinned model_review.py. One zero-shot prompt, no sweeps or repairs. Full native Statement with only released belief removed. No gold fields in requests. Source text is untrusted data.
model_review.schema: One required verdict/reason for every E01..En original evidence; no extra fields

native_baseline.features: Native CountsScorer raw source counts, DEV-only vocabulary, optional features and support ancestry off, all original evidence preserved

prior_exposure: Existing previously inspected corpus and fixed source/publication-group development/reserve split, reused for a new endpoint. Not a fresh blind benchmark. LLM pretraining overlap unknown.
purpose: Expert-relative source-to-mechanistic-claim faithfulness and selective pruning of a typed reference graph. Not experimental, clinical, universal biological or whole-Pharos accuracy.

reference.data_license: CC BY-NC-SA4.0; raw cases/text/labels kept private, not MIT relicensed
reference.title: Automated assembly of molecular mechanisms at scale from text mining and curated databases

scoring.automatic_deployment: No automatic Pharos/primary graph deletions. These decisions apply only to separate source-claim reference assessment graphs.
scoring.comparators: Native count model and fixed-prior SimpleScorer reported alongside retain-all, model-only and consensus. No selecting primary by outcome.
scoring.primary: Retained graph supported-label precision difference vs retain-all, with full removed-correct/incorrect counts and correct-label retention. Paired cluster bootstrap percentile95% intervals. Coverage and all abstentions retained.
scoring.unit: original assembled typed claim; group connected publication/source clusters

success_interpretation.advantage_over_native: Claim only if prespecified paired95% interval versus native_counts above0.
success_interpretation.bounded_gain: Retained supported-label precision paired95% interval vs retain-all above0, with counts/coverage/correct-claim retention prominently stated.
success_interpretation.safety: No universal safety claim from this sample. Correct-claim removals explicit; practical deployment remains review proposals.

supersedes.reason: Final scorer input-validation and fixture cleanup completed before any native model fit or new model inference. All scientific decisions, prompt and thresholds unchanged.
